text: All official coverage in mainland China is taken with a **tripod**. Objects in the image will usually have motion blur, and slightly saturated colours.
NOTE: Hong Kong and Macau both have full Google Car coverage.
_A separate Plonk It guide to Hong Kong can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/hong-kong). The Macau guide can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/macau)._
text_zh: 中國大陸的所有官方覆蓋都是用**三腳架**拍攝的。影像中的物件通常會有動態模糊，且色彩稍微過飽和。
NOTE: 香港與澳門皆有完整的 Google 車覆蓋。
_一份獨立的 Plonk It 香港指南可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/hong-kong)找到。澳門指南可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/macau)找到。_

text: Chinese writing consists of often complicated symbols made up of several strokes. On mainland China, you’ll typically find [simplified Chinese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simplified_Chinese_characters), where the number of strokes of many symbols have been greatly reduced compared to [traditional Chinese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Traditional_Chinese_characters).
NOTE: Traditional Chinese is widely used in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau.
text_zh: 中文書寫由通常由數個筆畫組成、往往複雜的符號所構成。在中國大陸，你通常會找到[簡體中文](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simplified_Chinese_characters)，與[繁體中文](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Traditional_Chinese_characters)相比，許多符號的筆畫數量已經大大減少。
註：繁體中文在台灣、香港與澳門廣泛使用。

text: Chinese licence plates are **blue** with white text.
text_zh: 中國車牌是**藍色**配白字。

text: Coverage in mainland China is limited to several small spots, mainly in or near major urban areas on the east coast. A significant portion of the coverage is considered **hidden**, which is also shown on this map. Hidden means it won’t show up on Google Maps, however you can still access it in the [Map Making App](https://map-making.app/).
text_zh: 中國大陸的街景覆蓋僅限於幾個小地點，主要位於東海岸的主要市區內或附近。相當大比例的覆蓋被認為是**隱藏的**，這也會顯示在地圖上。隱藏的意思是它不會顯示在 Google 地圖上，但你仍然可以在[地圖製作應用程式](https://map-making.app/)中存取它。

text: A significant portion of the coverage was taken **inside museums** and can be found in many cities, however a majority of the covered museums are located in and around Beijing and Shanghai.
text_zh: 相當大比例的覆蓋是在**博物館內部**拍攝的，可以在許多城市找到，不過絕大多數被覆蓋的博物館都位於北京和上海及其周邊地區。

text: **Ancient cities** with coverage can be found along the east coast in [Zhoucun](https://goo.gl/maps/HtrBBDFAqr4kmpsi7), northeast of [Xuzhou](https://goo.gl/maps/ZBQ6DJwNq9GaX48v5), in [Yangzhou](https://goo.gl/maps/Jv38RED54kjAMofy9), west of [Jiaxing](https://goo.gl/maps/9ShXFknmEMANdcw67) and west of [Zhangzhou](https://goo.gl/maps/obaDwScAwCNoynGs5).
text_zh: 擁有覆蓋的**古城**可以在東海岸的[周村](https://goo.gl/maps/HtrBBDFAqr4kmpsi7)、[徐州](https://goo.gl/maps/ZBQ6DJwNq9GaX48v5)東北方、[揚州](https://goo.gl/maps/Jv38RED54kjAMofy9)、[嘉興](https://goo.gl/maps/9ShXFknmEMANdcw67)西方以及[漳州](https://goo.gl/maps/obaDwScAwCNoynGs5)西方找到。

text: Coverage taken outside in modern **urban areas** can be found in [Beijing](https://goo.gl/maps/6LT8nsRuT7ZzY3t57), [Yangzhou](https://goo.gl/maps/Dka3nyFnF2jdkMAh8), [Shanghai](https://goo.gl/maps/Q3GDwGHXSckc6M7z7), [Shenzhen](https://goo.gl/maps/M6rYq1LDtTUvphnMA) and [Chengdu](https://goo.gl/maps/u334vZ7Q9KAFmYvW9).
text_zh: 在戶外現代**市區**拍攝的覆蓋可以在[北京](https://goo.gl/maps/6LT8nsRuT7ZzY3t57)、[揚州](https://goo.gl/maps/Dka3nyFnF2jdkMAh8)、[上海](https://goo.gl/maps/Q3GDwGHXSckc6M7z7)、[深圳](https://goo.gl/maps/M6rYq1LDtTUvphnMA)與[成都](https://goo.gl/maps/u334vZ7Q9KAFmYvW9)找到。

text: The Palace Museum (commonly referred to as the [Forbidden City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbidden_City)) is a **massive palace** in the centre of Beijing.
text_zh: 故宮博物院（通常被稱為[紫禁城](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbidden_City)）位於北京市中心，是一座**巨大的宮殿**。

text: By the Today Art Museum in Beijing you can find this modern urban street with several cafes and bars along the road. In front of the museum you can also find this [uncanny statue](https://goo.gl/maps/GE62dTna3EgiyzWv5).
text_zh: 在北京今日美術館旁，你可以找到這條現代城市街道，路旁有幾間咖啡廳與酒吧。在美術館前方，你也可以找到這個[詭異的雕像](https://goo.gl/maps/GE62dTna3EgiyzWv5)。

text: The **parking area** outside Sichuan Museum in Chengdu has a lot of **greenery**.
text_zh: 成都四川博物院外面的**停車場**有許多**綠化景觀**。

text: The Hubei Museum in Wuhan can be recognised by its **palace-like** architecture with **grey roofs**.
text_zh: 武漢的湖北省博物館可以透過其帶有**灰色屋頂**的**宮殿式**建築來識別。

text: The Museum of silk production in Hangzhou can be recognised by the **rounded glass facade** and the **fountain** by the front.
text_zh: 杭州的中國絲綢博物館可以透過**圓形玻璃立面**與前方的**噴泉**來識別。

text: Shanghai Long Museum can be recognised by the **boxy concrete main building**.
text_zh: 上海龍美術館可以透過**方正的混凝土主建築**來識別。

text: Suzhou Museum can be recognised by the white and grey **symmetric angular architecture**.
text_zh: 蘇州博物館可以透過白灰相間、**對稱的具稜角建築**來識別。

text: The Yangzhou Museum can be recognised by the **beige rounded stone building**.
text_zh: 揚州博物館可以透過**米色圓形石造建築**來識別。

text: The ancient city of Zhoucun is the only pinpointable ancient city in China, and can be recognised by the street going straight north to south.
text_zh: 周村古城是中國唯一可精準定位的古城，可以透過筆直貫通南北的街道來識別。
